## What changed

- Draft release notes now get one bullet per ticket when a pull request merges tickets, instead of one bullet for the whole pull request. (`release-notes-pr-tickets`)
- ADRs 0001, 0011, 0012, 0014 and 0020 and the decisions index now show that kmctl's APM package and each package's version live under `packages/<name>/apm` (ADR 0045), replacing the outdated `apm/` and `packages/kmaudit/VERSION` paths. (`adr-kmaudit-stale-lines`)
- The root README and both package READMEs now open with badges for lifecycle, CI, latest release, licence and Python, and kmaudit is marked beta in its README, badge, command reference and package metadata. (`readme-badges`)
- A new decision record says which package a feature belongs in by the direction it works: kmctl from code and decisions toward docs/ and .okf/, kmaudit from docs and .okf/ toward code, and the root README and CLAUDE.md point to it. (`package-direction`)
- A prototype measures on this repository's own history how well a deterministic filter plus an agent judge find merges that made a decision nobody recorded. (`decision-gaps-measure`)
- The new `kmctl decision candidates` command lists the changes since the newest decision record that may hold an unrecorded decision, with no model and without writing anything; each entry has what a judge needs and the list is ordered by decision-shaped signals, and ADR 0047 records the design. (`decision-candidates`)
- A new decision-gaps skill in kmctl's package runs `kmctl decision candidates`, judges every change it lists, and reports the changes that made a decision no record covers, each with the choice and the rejected option, writing nothing. (`decision-gaps-skill`)

## Other changes

- Test release notes for a pull request of tickets a sync brings in

## Install

```sh
uv tool install git+https://github.com/JasperHG90/kmctl@v0.14.0#subdirectory=packages/kmctl
```

In a workflow:

```yaml
- uses: JasperHG90/kmctl@v0.14.0
```
